items.s2_1: My cat is small and cute.
items.s2_3: The monkey has a long tail.
items.passage: Tom and Lily go to the zoo on Sunday. They see a big elephant and a tall horse. A monkey can jump and play. A tiger has orange and black lines. A turtle is slow, but it can swim. Lily likes the rabbit because it is small and cute. Tom likes the lion because it is strong.
items.s4_0: The rabbit is small and cute.
items.s4_1: A bird can fly in the sky.
items.s4_2: My dog has a black nose.
items.s4_3: The elephant is big and strong.
